The '''mission on Y'Trella''' was an operation undertaken by [[Churhee's Riflemen]], a pro-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Y'Trella]]. The mission resulted in a debacle and led to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of almost all the Riflemen, including their founder and leader, [[Vlaydm Churhee]].

==Prelude==
During their early [[Standard year/Legends|years]], [[Churhee's Riflemen]] regularly accepted missions from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Parmel sector/Legends|Parmel]] and [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]].<ref name="GAW" />

However, [[Vlaydm Churhee]], the leader of the Riflemen, was not a particularly loyal [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]. Vlaydm Churhee often breached contracts if offered enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], sometimes even switching allegiances in the middle of a battle. This behavior eventually led the Galactic Empire to consider Churhee's Riflemen as expendable.<ref name="AJ15" />

==The mission==
In around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Churhee's Riflemen accepted a job for the Galactic Empire on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Y'Trella]].<ref name="AJ12" />

During the operation, the group found itself pinned down by the enemy and abandoned by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] that had promised to provide backup. Almost all the Riflemen perished, and their founder, Vlaydm Churhee, was among the [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="GAW" />

==Aftermath==
After the debacle on Y'Trella, the survivors regrouped on [[Turcan III]] under the leadership of Vlaydm's widow, [[Maydla Churhee]].<ref name="GAW" />

In the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] that followed, Maydla Churhee rebuilt the unit, this time as a fiercely anti-Imperial organization. Thereafter, Churhee's Riflemen took anti-Imperial contracts only, and allied themselves with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="AJ15" />
